verdicts.verify_by: in a scratch worktree at ecf7af0: `sed -i 's|up := strings.Repeat("../", depth)|up := strings.Repeat("../", depth+1)|' misc/gnopreview/crawl.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test ./...` — expect a failure, observe `ok`
verdicts.tldr: no test runs rewrite's own depth derivation, so a wrong `up` ships every preview link and asset broken with CI green
verdicts.details: rewrite() derives up from the page's own directory (crawl.go:350-351) and that value is what every href, src and css url() in the published tree is built from. TestMapURL declares `const up = "../../../"` at crawl_test.go:129 and passes it in, and rewrite's only caller in the suite, TestRewriteAddsNoindex, feeds bodies with no href or src at all, so the derivation runs in no assertion. Changing depth to depth+1 leaves the whole package `ok`, while a page at r/x/y/index.html then points "/r/a/b" at "../../../../r/a/b/", one directory above the preview root. Fix: assert the resolved target, not the string — path.Join(path.Dir(p.File), rewritten) must equal the captured file's own directory, for a shallow page and a /_t/ page.
verdicts.evidence: Head ecf7af0f, scratch worktree, go1.25.9. Baseline `go test -vet=off -count=1 .` -> ok 0.004s. Mutation crawl.go:351 depth -> depth+1 (git diff --stat: 1 file changed, 1 insertion, 1 deletion), same command -> `ok  github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview  0.004s`: the shipped suite does not see it. My own TestJudge153RewriteResolvesFromThePageDir passes at the unmutated head and goes red on the mutation with `page r/x/y/index.html: "/r/a/b" rewritten to "../../../../r/a/b/", which resolves to "../r/a/b"; want "r/a/b" — the published link 404s`, and again for /public/css/main.css and for the deeper r/x/y/_t/source/index.html. Merge base has no misc/ directory at all, so nothing to compare there.

verdicts.verify_by: `sed -i 's|if loc := headRe.FindStringIndex(body); loc != nil {|if loc := headRe.FindStringIndex(body); false && loc != nil {|' misc/gnopreview/crawl.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestRewriteAddsNoindex ./...` — expect a failure, observe `ok`
verdicts.tldr: the robots-meta test counts the tag but never says where it landed, so the <head> insertion can die and every preview page ships in quirks mode
verdicts.details: setNoindex has three branches (crawl.go:371-378) and the last is `return noindexTag + body`. TestRewriteAddsNoindex's four assertions check presence, a count of 1, a single robots meta and the absence of "index, follow" — the fallback satisfies all four, for the two cases (`normal head`, `head with attrs`) that exist to exercise the headRe insertion. With the head branch dead, the tag is prepended ahead of `<!doctype html>`, and content before the doctype puts the page into quirks mode: the preview a reviewer is asked to judge gnoweb's CSS by would box differently than gno.land. Fix: assert the tag's index falls between `<head` and `</head>`, and that no byte precedes the doctype.

verdicts.tldr: the trailing-slash early return in inScope decides nothing, since no realm path can produce a urlOf ending in a slash
verdicts.details: urlOf returns "/"+pkgPath-after-the-first-slash (crawl.go:470-476), and Realms is either gnowebSeedRealms or pkgs[p].Path from BuildPlan's package scan (plan.go:228-262), so no urlOf(r) ends in "/". A base ending in "/" therefore fails the realm match at crawl.go:196 and inScope returns false with or without the guard at crawl.go:191-193. The three lines and their comment are redundant, not wrong, and the case at crawl_test.go:86 asserts the behaviour rather than the guard. The finder's stated loss does not follow: were the realm match later changed to admit directory URLs, the guard would still refuse them, so nothing published is at risk today. Fix: drop the three lines and move their comment onto the realm match, or leave them as documented intent.
